samples.identification: Go Telegram-controlled multichain clipboard hijacker and seed stealer
samples.reason: Hardcoded destination substitution, copied seed/voucher export, remote screenshot control, autorun and Defender exclusion make this malicious. Authorized research deployment is possible but not evidenced; family aliases are not reliable identity.
samples.marker: Go clipper: wallet swaps and seed theft; behavior coverage added

samples.reason: Byte-identical BusyBox 1.23.1 hush regression test. It creates/truncates and deletes PID-named local files to verify assignment scope and redirection; no URLs/dependencies or hidden code. External hostile reason is unavailable; upstream identity and transparent test behavior indicate a collection/source mislabel.
samples.marker: BusyBox hush test: redirection and scope checks; coverage added

samples.reason: Byte-identical BusyBox 1.23.1 ash regression test. exec only closes stdout; it does not launch a program. Writes TEST, verifies stdout remains closed, reads through stderr, and deletes TEST. No URLs/dependencies. External hostile reason is unavailable; a generic exec/redirection heuristic or source mislabel is plausible, not established.
samples.marker: BusyBox ash test: closed-fd regression; coverage added

evidence.behavior: Entry invokes singleton guard, antiSandbox, Defender exclusion, autorun installer; sends host/geolocation report, launches admin-command listener and repeatedly processes clipboard changes.
Initializes 12 regexes, including 12–24-word seed phrases, cryptocurrency addresses, CryptoBot vouchers and Steam trade links; detector returns matched kind.
Reads CF_UNICODETEXT and acts only on changes. SEED_PHRASE dispatch sends the original clipboard text through SendSeedNotification; voucher dispatch reports copied CryptoBot checks.

Builds hardcoded replacement map for BTC/BNB/ETH/LTC/DOGE/TRX/TON/XMR/SOL and Steam links. Looks up detected kind, compares original to replacement, then passes replacement string to writeClipboardSyscall and reports both strings.

Formats seed phrase plus host/geolocation fields in a Telegram HTML report, marshals JSON and calls HTTP Client.Post to configured Telegram Bot API. Token and chat ID are compiled in; no live request made.
Captures desktop through GDI, converts pixels and JPEG-encodes them, then uploads returned bytes as multipart photo. Capture and photo-send calls are 438 bytes apart.
Repeated getUpdates polling, JSON decode, command/callback dispatch for info, ping and screenshot. Screenshot requests invoke SendScreenshotToChat.
Copies current executable to AppData/svchost_task.exe, appends 1024–3071 random bytes, sets Hidden|System attributes (6), and writes HKCU CurrentVersion/Run WindowsUpdate value to installed path.
Launches hidden PowerShell with -Command Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath and quoted AppData path. Runtime success and elevation are not established.
Delays 15–29 seconds and terminates for low CPU/RAM/disk resources, analyst-like hostnames, VM guest drivers, debugger presence and installed analysis tools.

decoded_content: Recovered stack strings are Go runtime/library text. Heuristic Base64 candidates decode to non-code bytes, not a staged script. No archive members or parser errors. No evidence of a separate activated payload in the overlay; random padding is also appended by the installer.

capture_name.reason: The matcher establishes the source identifier string only; a benign stub with this name matched the original suspicious rule. Exact text matcher and effective PE/Windows scope retained; suspicious to notable. Textual identifier vocabulary belongs with source naming. The named screen-sharing consumer was updated without changing its required evidence.
capture_name.consumer_audit: Searched exact ID and ancestor YAML references; the sole exact consumer is go-telegram-controlled-screen-sharing. No ancestor-directory consumer selects this name-only atom. No matching existing testdata or other original PE sample was found; native benign control confirms retained identifier coverage.

shared_rule_review.post: Extended existing HTTP POST function reference matcher to equivalent compiled Go net/http Post/Client.Post symbols. Preserves prior http.Post matches; source positive and comment/string-only near miss passed. Inspected exact consumers and source-only dependent composites; original native gains only intended six hostile objectives.
shared_rule_review.capacity: Audited effective definitions in metadata/binary/symbols/name and communications/http/post: no exact duplicates. No budget changes, artificial splits, or accurate detector deletions.

controls.name-only.exe: Old exact matcher hits main.captureScreen; revised rules retain notable identifier and call reference; zero hostile/suspicious findings.
controls.redirection-near-miss.tests: Comments and quoted exec/redirection examples trigger none of the new redirection/descriptor rules.
controls.post.go: Existing http-post detection retained for real source HTTP call.
controls.post-near-miss.go: A string describing http.Post does not trigger the symbol matcher.
controls.no-clipboard-write-call.exe: NOP only E8 at 0x140295035; clipboard hijack and dependent objectives disappear; independent seed export remains hostile.
controls.no-seed-send-call.exe: NOP only E8 at 0x140294a0e; seed export disappears; five other hostile objectives remain.

limitations: No Windows runtime execution or Telegram contact; success is not needed to establish these static attack paths.
External malware family aliases are not established by this analysis. Program is identified by its verified Go clipboard-hijacker/seed-stealer behavior.
Atomscan model v18.18 warns its feature specification is older than the expected v21. Scores support all three judgments; text samples lack a calibrated categorical verdict.
material_detection_losses: None. Only original suspicious screenshot identifier was relocated and corrected to notable; every other previously firing trait is retained.
remaining_rule_or_classifier_disagreemen: No hostile coverage gap in the identified attack paths. Model probabilities support judgments; no calibrated categorical verdict is supplied for the benign text files.
